meaning:
φύω
[in LXX: Pro.26:9, Eze.37:8 (עָלָה), etc. ;]
1. trans., to bring forth, produce (of men, to beget); pass., to spring up, grow: Luk.8:6, 8.
2. Intrans., in 2 aor., pf., plpf., and rarely in present (see LS, see word, A, II.), to spring up: Heb.12:15.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: as soon as it was sprung up

elsewhere.note: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it,
